layout.arrangement: A thin red rectangular frame outlines the entire slide. Title 'Neural Network Model' is centered at the top in bold dark red; a yellow circle badge with '29' sits in the top-right corner. On the row just below the title, a magenta 'Input Sample' box is at the far left and a magenta 'Target Label' box is at the upper right, joined by a horizontal dashed magenta arrow pointing right. The middle-left is dominated by a large beige rectangular panel containing a 3-layer feed-forward neural-network diagram (input dots → summation/activation nodes → weighted links → output nodes → Output 1/2/m boxes). Immediately right of that panel is a tall dark-red vertical bar with rotated white text 'Error Error Error', and to its right a vertical stack of three pale-green 'Class 1 / Class 2 / Class m' boxes. The upper-right quadrant holds a beige legend box with red border (Net_j / O_j / w_ji definitions) and, below it, a white box with red border giving the I/P and O/P node counts. Beneath the network panel are two up-arrow callouts: a blue-outlined arrow with a light-blue 'Previous Layer / Layer (i)' box under the middle node column, and a green-outlined arrow with a light-green 'Current Layer / (You are here)' box under the right node column. The bottom strip contains, from left to right: a white header box 'For Layer “j”' above a pale-yellow formula box (Net_j = ∑ (w_ji O_i)); a centered pale-yellow formula box (O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^{-Net_j})); and, at the right, a white header box 'If Layer “j” is Output Layer:' above a pale-yellow error formula box (E = 1/2 ∑ (t_j - O_j)^2).

Bright saturated node colors (red sigma, blue middle layer, green current layer) and the magenta input/target boxes provide the next level of emphasis. The dark-red vertical 'Error Error Error' bar is a strong narrow accent. The right-hand legend and note boxes are secondary, and the bottom formula boxes are the lightest-weight elements (pale yellow fills, thin gray borders).

visual_elements.description: Feed-forward neural network inside a beige panel. Far left: 4 small filled magenta/purple dots (input nodes) stacked vertically at roughly y = 41%, 45%, 49%, 53% of slide height; thin light-gray lines fan from them to three white circles in column 1 (x ≈ 17%; y ≈ 33%, 46%, 60%). Each column-1 circle is bisected by a vertical line, with a red '∑' in the left half and a red S-shaped sigmoid squiggle in the right half. Immediately right of each column-1 circle are three small empty gray circles ('o o o') indicating omitted nodes. Column 2 (x ≈ 27%): three white circles with blue outlines, red '∑' in the left half, blue sigmoid squiggle in the right half, each with a small filled red dot on its right edge; red italic bold 'Net_j' above the column and red italic bold 'O_j' to the right of each node. Column 3 (x ≈ 45%): three white circles with green outlines, red '∑' in the left half, green sigmoid squiggle in the right half, each with a small filled red dot on its left edge; red italic bold 'Net_j' above the column and red italic bold 'O_j' to the right of each node. Nine thin pink/red lines connect every column-2 node to every column-3 node (fully connected); three of these links carry blue italic bold 'w_ji' labels (one above the top horizontal link near x ≈ 35%, and two on the descending diagonal links below it). To the right of column 3 are three small white rectangles with black outlines and italic black text: 'Output 1' (top), 'Output 2' (middle), 'Output m' (bottom).
